about: The model of each AI part. Model names only, never a key. Nothing else sets a model (no environment variable or vault secret); a part left out uses its module's default. Claude tasks take claude-… ids; «picture» is kie.ai's picture model, «picture-openai» OpenAI's, «embeddings» the RAG search's OpenAI model, «speech» and «speech-fa» ElevenLabs' voices' models. «voices» are ElevenLabs' voice IDs per language and woman / man (the app's choice in the settings). A merge to main reaches the server within about two minutes. See aigateway.js.
